foundingStory: ACI began its journey as a Village Ministry in Mannurpet, a suburb of Chennai. Our initial focus was on assisting the poor and marginalized through various services: offering free educational programs to empower children and adults, providing clothing to those in need, especially during seasonal changes, and organizing food drives and community kitchens to feed the hungry.
tagline: A vibrant community of faith, dedicated to spreading the Gospel and serving those in need.
missionStatement: Welcome to the Apostolic Church of India (ACI), founded and led by our esteemed Pastor Dr. Rev. D. D. K. Rathna Raju. Established in 1970 in Chennai, the capital of Tamil Nadu, ACI has grown from humble beginnings into a vibrant community of faith, dedicated to spreading the Gospel and serving those in need. At the heart of ACI's mission is the desire to spread the love and message of Jesus Christ. Our vision is to create a community where individuals can grow in faith, find support, and experience the love of God in their lives.
